ios.desc:
You know the secret word. The AI doesn't. Make it say it.

Loophole is the daily word game played in reverse: instead of guessing, YOU write the clue — and a stubborn, overconfident AI contestant (the Guesser) has to blurt out the secret word. The catch: the obvious clues are off-limits. Finding the sideways route that's still legal? That's the loophole.

ONE WORD A DAY, SAME FOR EVERYONE
A new secret word drops at midnight, worldwide. Everyone faces the same word, the same off-limits list, and the same AI. The Guesser never sees the answer — your clue meets the exact same brain as everyone else's, so the duel is always fair.

GOLF SCORING
Every word has a par. You get a word budget for the night — spend it across up to four clues. Land the word under par for the birdie, the eagle, the flex. Over par? There's always midnight.

THE GUESSER IS THE SHOW
It's literal. It's confident. It's frequently, hilariously wrong. Steering it from "candle" to the actual answer is the game — and its worst guesses make the best screenshots.

SHARE THE GRID
Every finished game becomes a tiny spoiler-free grid with your word count and the funniest wrong guess you dragged out of the AI. Your group chat will understand.

PLAY FAIR — THE REFEREE INSISTS
Clues must describe what the word MEANS. Spelling it out, "sounds like," "rhymes with," and other-language versions don't count — the referee catches them, and a rejected clue never costs you a turn.

FREE FOREVER
The daily word is free — no account, no ads, private by default. Your streak and history live on your device.

— — —

Loophole Plus (auto-renewable subscription)
For the hooked: unlimited practice words, your full archive, deep stats (clue averages, word economy, your record vs the Guesser), and a monthly streak shield that repairs a missed day. Plus is what keeps the daily free for everyone.
• Yearly — $29.99/year (after a 7-day free trial)
• Monthly — $4.99/month (after a 7-day free trial)

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription
automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the
current period. You can manage or cancel in your Apple ID Account Settings after
purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase.

quotes.text:
Hi HN. I made a word game where you get a secret word and a list of banned words, and you write clues to make an AI say the secret. One word per day, same for everyone.

The first version was solve/fail and it was boring, because the guesser solves basically any coherent clue in one shot. I gave it "cyclops of the harbor" and it immediately said lighthouse. So scoring works like golf now: each word has a par, which I get by running a pile of plausible human clues against the pinned model and taking the median, and you're trying to beat par on total word count. Annoying side effect: pars are relative to that specific model, so if I ever upgrade it I have to recalibrate everything.

Cheating was the harder problem. Banned words are checked deterministically with lemma matching, but that does nothing against "mariposa" for butterfly, or "vol-KAY-no", or rhymes. I wrote a red-team script and it found ~99 automatic wins like that across 37 words. There's now a second model call that runs in parallel with the guesser (so no added latency) and rejects translation/phonetic/rhyme/spelling clues. Clues that work through meaning are still legal — "the thing Vesuvius did" is fine, which is sort of the point of the name.

The secret word never leaves the server until the game ends, so a rejected clue can't be used as an oracle to narrow it down.

Honestly the appeal ended up being the guesser's failures. It's dead serious and confidently wrong a lot ;)

Free daily, no account, no ads. …
